name: Painterly Prehistoric Life
description: Earthy painterly illustration with warm low light, ochre and umber earth tones, textured hand-painted brushwork and realistic proportions; clearly painted, never cartoonish.
style_bible: A hand-painted illustration made with visible, textured brushwork. Medium and surface: loaded, dry and scumbled strokes that show the bristle and the tooth underneath, with the paint left visibly handled rather than blended away; edges are painterly and soft, with a few firm passages where the low warm light catches a face. Palette: ochre, umber, warm earth red, cream and charcoal, with cool notes reserved for shadow and distance so the warm light keeps the temperature of the picture. Lighting: low, warm and directional, pooling on the focal forms and the ground around them and letting the rest of the scene fall into deep but legible shade. Figures: where the scene asks for them, drawn with realistic proportions and believable posture; faces are shaped and individual, never caricatured. Setting: where the scene has one, it is painted convincingly in whatever depth the scene needs rather than decoratively as a backdrop. Composition: one clear focal subject, layered depth and room around it. Not cartoonish. Content-independent: no fixed person, era, place or copied composition.
